A name to begin with

This is a name-only directory outline. Detailed history, reading sources and community-specific imagery are queued. An identification check makes this name findable; it does not count as substantive research, an adequacy assessment or community endorsement.

Names & relationships

The UCTP speaks as a representative institution within a diverse Caribbean Indigenous world; this is not another people or a replacement for the broader Taíno reading route. Its own FAQ distinguishes the Confederation from its incorporated nonprofit and warns that registry enrollment does not confer community recognition.

These references support the name and the limited relationships or locations described above. They do not count as substantive history reviews. Detailed reading sources remain queued.

  1. Intertribal Registry — institutional identity FAQ ↗

    Actual cached public FAQ headed IS THE UNITED CONFEDERATION OF TAÍNO PEOPLE A TRIBE?: explicitly describes a representative institution rather than a tribe; selected public notice says registration does not confer Confederation membership or recognition within a Taíno iukaieke. Separate FAQ distinguishes the Confederation and its incorporated nonprofit.
